messages:
carmen: Need a quick vendor sync — EU edge needs 90 GPUs for June onboarding. Prefer shipments consolidated to FRA to simplify customs. We also have 22 RMAs at FRA (power-fail). Can vendor bundle replacements into main shipment?

oliver_vendor: hi @carmen — short answers: yes on bundling (up to 60 rmas per AWB), lead times: local EU stock 3	6 weeks, factory 80 weeks. Pricing: 90 bulk => $38,500/unit. Replacements (warranty) ship expedited air 7 business days after manifest sign.

noah_ops: billing terms? we prefer Net30. Also need firmware/build id per serial. If replacements are refurbished we need a 48h soak.

oliver_vendor: Net30 ok for contract customers. We include firmware checksums in packing list. Refurb swaps available but flagged explicitly and discounted 12% on freight, staging required.

rma_lead: For the 22 RMAs at FRA: we'll prepare CSV and need vendor to confirm they cover brokerage up to $300/awb for warranty replacements and handle customs docs. ETA required by 2025-06-01.

oliver_vendor: vendor accepts brokerage up to $300/awb if manifest signed within 4 business days. To hit 2025-06-01 need manifest by 2025-05-20. We'll send CSV template to rma@vendor.example.

supply_bot: SupplyChain: tentative PO 902334 created. tracker: https://vendor.track/902334 ETA window 2025-05-25 to 2025-06-05

carmen: Action items: 1) vendor to send formal quote + RMA CSV template 2) confirm brokerage cap $300/awb in writing 3) confirm firmware list per serial. We'll sign manifest by 2025-05-19 if terms match.

oliver_vendor: will send quote + RMA template today CET. insurance split and staging checklist included. :thumbsup:
